notes.title: Dash Island has returned (2025)!
notes.content:
The game is back on Steam.
 Rebuilt using a more modern game engine.
 Improved Graphics & Visuals.
 Faster, Cleaner, 16:9 finally.

notes.title: Dash Island - Temporary Removal
notes.content:
- I found some major issues within the game.
- I'm removing the game from the store so that no one can purchase it while the issues are still present.
- This will not effect current users who already own the game or the game demo.

notes.title: Gigantic Update - 78 Levels, Open World
notes.content:
Levels have been increased from 18 to 78

 Open world concept, where you have open access to multiple levels, thus adding the luxury of playing a diverse set of levels from the very start

 The graphics have improved, displaying messages and level introductions

 The Storyline has been cut out, providing a more user friendly experience

 Wait times have been sped up, to get the user engaged in playing quicker than ever

 Collect over 230 Pysankas "Little Ukrainian Eggs"

notes.title: Dash Island V2.5
notes.content:
Minor Update

Swim Tiles Fixed
- It's easier to enter and exit the swim tiles.
- New Safe Zone; Enemies can't capture you from in the water when you are on land, and vice versa.

Better Tutorial
- The tutorial has gone through an overhaul. Breaking down the game elements in a more understandable way, while keeping the instructions clean and precise.

Improved HUD
- Level Signs have been added to the top of your display when entering and exiting levels. This will make it easier to keep track of what level you are in and the level select areas you roam around.

Frame Rate Improvement
- The main level select area has been split up from one massive area to three separate areas to increase frame rates while playing.

notes.title: Update V2.0
notes.content:
- New Menu System
- New Help Menu "Orange CPU"
- New, Cleaner Graphics
- Fixed Many Bugs
- Introduction has been remade for faster start time
- Internal work done to make the game run smoother
